name: Unitus
body: Started with a conversion pass on Unitus' footwear funnel: a rebuilt PDP with a size and fit guide, sticky mobile add-to-cart, gallery zoom, and social proof, plus a cart drawer with a tiered free-shipping bar, upsells, and checkout trust elements.

That turned into a ground-up redesign of the whole store. I built a Figma design system and component library, then developed every page on Shopify's Horizon theme, carrying the PDP and cart work forward instead of starting over.

name: Moto Machines
body: Migrated Moto Machines, a motorcycle performance parts retailer, onto Shopify, from mobile-first Figma wireframes for every template through to launch.

The centerpiece is a custom "Select Your Bike" year/make/model finder built on metaobjects and JavaScript, alongside a mega-menu for brands and categories, Search & Discovery filtering, and a full SEO migration with schema, meta, and redirects.

name: Turtle Fur
body: A phased theme engagement for Turtle Fur's headwear and neckwear brand. Phase 1 rolled out their brand refresh across the theme: new heading typography and a color-scheme system applied site-wide on desktop and mobile.
Phases 2 and 3 rebuilt the homepage hero carousel and brought the remaining modules in line with the new brand system, so merchandising teams can keep shipping campaigns without touching code.

name: AbMat
body: Designed and built a new storefront for AbMat's fitness equipment line. Discovery and a brand audit fed a custom Figma design system and high-fidelity desktop and mobile mockups for the homepage, PDP, collection, and cart.
I then developed it on Shopify's Horizon theme, with conversion-focused PDP components built in from the start rather than bolted on after launch.

name: TruLabs
body: Ongoing partner to TruLabs since 2024. I've built a custom influencer discount on Shopify Functions with monthly usage limits and caps, a metafield-driven quantity selector tied to Recharge pricing, Rebuy bundles with a cart progress bar, and flavor and color swatch logic on the PDP.

I also migrated their wholesale business to native Shopify B2B (customers, catalogs, and checkout validation) and upgraded their Impulse theme to the latest version with every customization carried over.

name: Cotton Citizen
body: Built a B2B ordering experience into Cotton Citizen's existing theme. Logged-in wholesale buyers get a quick-order grid on the PDP with every size, live inventory, and per-size quantities in a single add to bag.

To protect direct-to-consumer stock, I added product- and variant-level inventory floors for B2B accounts, enforced server-side with a Shopify Functions checkout validation. I also shipped PLP image controls and tabbed PDP content.

name: Strong Cell
body: Rebuilt Strong Cell's product hero and landing pages around a modern supplement buy box with subscribe-and-save, supply-length options, and one-time purchase, designed in Figma and built natively into the theme.
Later I generalized the buy box so it works across every product and fixed edge cases in the subscription and one-time purchase selection logic.

name: Bulbs Direct
body: Working with New Zealand's Bulbs Direct since 2022. I consolidated their variants and built configurable quantity breaks with stepped quantity selectors on the PDP and in the cart, capped to available inventory.
When Shopify Scripts was retired, I migrated their tiered quantity discounts to an automatic Shopify Functions discount and moved the tag-based rules into metafields.

name: Shut Up & Love Your Neighbor
body: Redesigned the store for a message-driven apparel brand. I sourced and customized a premium theme, set up a brand style guide for typography, color, and imagery, and built the homepage, collection, product, and about pages.
The layout leads with the brand's message and keeps the path to purchase low-friction, all running on their Printify print-on-demand catalog.

name: Sela Vie Creative
body: Development partner to Sela Vie Creative, a creative studio for founder-led brands, on Shopify builds for their clients since 2024.

Work includes a multi-brand storefront with its own layouts, templates, and brand switcher, and a full trade center: a dashboard for trade customers, collection-based trade pricing, project wishlists, order tracking, and printable PDP tearsheets.

name: Cali Poke House
body: Took Cali Poke House, a trading card and collectibles shop, from React prototypes to a live Shopify store. I finished and deployed their custom theme, wired every setting to live storefront output, and connected the homepage sections to real collections.
I also built the mobile slide-out navigation from scratch, with nested categories for Pokémon, One Piece, blind boxes, and plush.
